children: Portugal's economy grew 0.8% in the second quarter from the previous three months, up from 0.1% in the first quarter, driven by net exports and private consumption, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Friday, confirming its initial estimate.
In its second reading of GDP, INE also said the economy expanded 2.5% year-on-year in the second quarter, matching its preliminary estimate from a month earlier and up from 2.4% in the first quarter.
The government expects the economy to grow by 2% this year, slightly above the 1.9% growth recorded in 2025.
